_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: Universal deployment platform. Upload a ZIP or paste a repo URL and it detects the framework and ships it to Vercel, Netlify, or Render, with OAuth-based deploys so the server never touches your tokens.
Aurora, an AFK bot built on Mineflayer that actually behaves like a player: random movement, auto-eat, pathfinding, chat commands, auto-reconnect, and a live status dashboard.
Personal portfolio site, responsive with a project showcase, skills section, and smooth-scroll animations.
